title: License details: updates ended
summary: The same DJDL page for Kenji, whose yearly Studio license stopped renewing on Sep 30, 2026 and keeps the last version (licenses.list's 'Updates ended … keeps working' row): DJDL keeps working on 4.1.3, which leads Get it and the header's one solid action; 4.2.0 is one quiet Not included row; the lapse is said once at the top with Renew and once in full in the License card. The phone render emails the 4.1.3 download.
compare: Header: a warning pill 'Updates ended' beside the primary action, which downloads the last covered version ('Download 4.1.3', the page's only solid button), never a build the license doesn't cover. A keeps-the-last-version lapse is a warning, not 'Expired · danger' (that stays for stop licenses; PORTAL.md §5.3 needs the row).

Said once at the top and once in full: the pill and the info callout '4.2.0 isn't in your license' (with the cover date and the link 'Renew with Example Audio ↗') at the top; the duration block in full. Everywhere else only quiet marks: the muted 4.2.0 row, 'not in your license' on What's new, 'your version' on 4.1.3.

Get it: the recommended build is 4.1.3 with an outlined Download; the list starts 'Your version, 4.1.3' with its macOS and Windows rows (SHA-256, copy, Download), then one quiet row '4.2.0 for macOS and Windows · Released after your updates ended · Not included' in muted regular weight, with no SHA-256, copy or download.

Duration block: 'Updates ended at 4.1.3' (LX-15's line 'Updates ended at 4.1.3 · keeps working'), 'Keeps working · the yearly renewal stopped on Sep 30, 2026', the bar full from 'Renewed Sep 30, 2025' to Sep 30, 2026 and the 'Today, Oct 7' marker in the dashed stretch labelled 4.1.3; the track visible in both themes.

The sentence: the license renewed every year until Sep 30, 2026; DJDL keeps working on 4.1.3, the last version released before then, for as long as you like; to get 4.2.0 and later, renew with Example Audio. Then Renew with Example Audio as an outlined button with the external-link glyph (the developer's renew link, opens their site).
A stop license (no keeps-the-last-version) never gets this copy: it shows 'Ended Sep 30, 2026' and 'Renew with Example Audio to keep using it'.

Facts: Activated Sep 30, 2024, License source 'From Example Audio' (issued by hand), Works offline for 30 days, Release track Stable. No 'Covers versions' fact: the duration title says it. The holder box tells a new device to sign in with the account email.
Included keeps the tier's entitlements (Stem separation, 4 decks, Recording, Cloud Sync): keeps-the-last-version keeps entitlements, only newer versions stop.
What's new keeps 4.2.0's notes with 'not in your license' in its subtitle; Earlier versions marks 4.1.3 'your version'.

Devices shows two devices on 4.1.3 with no warning: a lapsed keeps-the-last-version license is not an error on a device. Ten devices draw as a bar, not ten segments. Remove and Delete synced data confirm as on portal.license.

Phone renders stand for a phone user agent (PORTAL.md §5.4, 'Expired, an older build is covered'): the pill on its own line, then 'Email me the download' (solid, full width) and the overflow; the recommended card becomes the callout 'We'll email kenji@example.com a link to 4.1.3 that opens on your Mac or PC.'; no 'this device'.
Phone: the pill tabs scroll sideways with a faded edge, License marked; Cloud Sync's buttons stack below 380 px; the footer sits above the bottom bar, whose Activate is the outlined pill.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Needs fixes, now applied: one solid button, the downloadable 4.1.3 builds grouped first with 4.2.0 as one quiet row, the phone emails the download, and the lapse is said once at the top and once in full.

findings.issue: Three solid violet buttons (header Download 4.1.3, recommended Download, Renew) with no clear main action.
findings.resolution: Header 'Download 4.1.3' is the only solid button; the recommended Download is outlined; Renew with Example Audio is an outlined button with the external-link glyph, and is also the link in the '4.2.0 isn't in your license' callout.

findings.issue: All platforms mixed 4.2.0 Not included rows with 4.1.3 downloads; bold 'Not included' was the strongest text; rows you can't download kept a SHA-256 and copy.
findings.resolution: Grouped: 'Your version, 4.1.3' with its macOS and Windows rows, then one quiet row '4.2.0 for macOS and Windows · Released after your updates ended · Not included' in muted regular weight (the kit draws Rubik at 400 and 700 only, so no medium weight), with no SHA-256, copy or download. The row has no second Renew: the callout at the top of the same card carries it (density finding).

findings.issue: Phone header was the pill plus a solid 'Download 4.1.3'; PORTAL.md §5.4 gives 'Email me the download'.
findings.resolution: Phone: the pill on its own line, then 'Email me the download' (solid, full width, §5.4's words; the email names 4.1.3) and the overflow; the recommended card becomes the callout 'We'll email kenji@example.com a link to 4.1.3 that opens on your Mac or PC.'; no 'this device'.

findings.issue: The '4.2.0 isn't in your license' callout had no action; the only Renew was about 1,400 px further down on phone.
findings.resolution: 'Renew with Example Audio ↗' is the callout's link, under its text rather than in the trailing slot, which would squeeze the text into a narrow column on phone.

findings.issue: The lapse was said about nine times, reading as alarm.
findings.resolution: Said once at the top (pill, callout with Renew) and once in full (duration block). Dropped the 'Covers versions' fact (Release track takes its place), the holder box's 'and install 4.1.3' and the two 'Released after your updates ended' rows (one quiet row now); 'yours to keep' became 'your version'; What's new keeps 'not in your license'.

findings.issue: The bar's left end read 'Sep 30, 2025' while Activated said Sep 30, 2024.
Versus house doc: the warning 'Updates ended' pill is better than PORTAL.md §5.3's 'Expired · danger'.
findings.resolution: No mockup change. The PORTAL.md §5.3 update (an 'Updates ended · warning' row for keeps-the-last-version licenses, quick action Download <last covered version>; 'Expired · danger' only for stop licenses) is noted for the lead: PORTAL.md is outside the mockups directory.
